title: GreenPoint | Every judgment has a frame
voice_direction: American female; warm, clear, confident; brief pauses for visible actions; no exaggerated advertising delivery.

scenes.title: 一个可核查的分歧
scenes.narration: This tiny plant was labeled crop. The annotation says weed. GreenPoint makes that disagreement inspectable.
scenes.action_zh: 同一公开图像中的23像素植物：先显示前实验的crop框，再揭示公开标注weed与新农业检测框。保留selected example。

scenes.title: 用户问题与Meta职责
scenes.narration: For growers reviewing scattered fields, a label alone isn't enough. Our online flow uses Sam three point one for plant regions, and Muse Spark for structured visual suggestions.
scenes.action_zh: 展示现有真实线上工作区与SAM、Muse职责。明确Recorded real Meta run。
scenes.provenance: Actual online product / recorded Meta inference

scenes.title: 一次完整的复核
scenes.narration: Select a candidate. Its box connects to pixels from that exact source image. Zoom and pan: the evidence stays with the plant. Here, the model suggests weed. I keep it for review and save. The original suggestion and my decision remain separate.
scenes.action_zh: 使用一次连续GP-001缩放平移，再显示Keep for review、Save与原始/人工状态；不重复展示同类清单。
scenes.provenance: Actual online review interactions / same session

scenes.title: 判断随记录导出
scenes.narration: Switch to the video inventory, then export. The same review follows the session. The CSV preserves the original label, human status, source, and run identity.
scenes.action_zh: 切Video，点击实际导出，放大刚导出的真实CSV字段；不编造表格。

scenes.title: Muse实际调用工具
scenes.narration: Muse can request evidence too. In this separate recorded run, it discovers our M C P tools and requests authenticated frame perception. Seven candidates come back. Muse cites evidence IDs and chooses human review.
scenes.action_zh: 按discover、perception、human_review顺序各显示一次真实调用回放，并放大公开trace原字段。
scenes.provenance: Separate real Muse agent trace / software only

scenes.title: 实际本地农业识别
scenes.narration: We then tested a local agricultural expert, using published PhenoBench weights. This is real CPU inference on the same RGB frame, with no annotations sent to the model. It is a research prototype, separate from the online Meta flow.
scenes.action_zh: 展示本轮实际重新运行的RGB输入、检测输出、运行耗时与模型来源。不是线上功能录屏，不做伪造加载进度。
scenes.provenance: Actual local CPU output / published pretrained weights
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

scenes.title: 定位找回案例
scenes.narration: On this selected example, the previous pipeline missed a fifty-one-pixel weed. The agricultural detector recovers its box. Both views show the same source pixels, checked against the public annotation.
scenes.action_zh: 源图定位51像素目标并放大；并排前方案、新检测器，最后揭示同源GT。放大只用原始像素。
scenes.provenance: Selected public-data example / same source pixels
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

scenes.title: 完整同图评测
scenes.narration: We chose settings on twenty calibration images, then evaluated forty different images. On that same comparison, weed precision rose from seventy-six point one to ninety-six point seven percent. Recall stayed near sixty-one percent. False weed flags fell from thirty-seven to four.
scenes.action_zh: 同40张196株杂草的实验对照：precision76.1→96.7、recall60.2→60.7、falseflags37→4；不得拿另一批39.7%作因果提升。
scenes.provenance: Frozen local research comparison / full 40-image cohort
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

scenes.title: 切片碎片去重对照
scenes.narration: Tiles add fragments. Containment cleanup raised tile precision from eighty-seven point two to ninety-two point five percent, with sixty-three point three percent recall.
scenes.action_zh: 展示真实切片预测中被包含的小框和保留完整框，接固定消融指标。说明selected整图不使用该去重。
scenes.provenance: Separate fixed tile ablation / not the primary method
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

scenes.title: 小目标局限与人工复核
scenes.narration: The smallest weeds remain difficult: nineteen of seventy targets at thirty-two pixels or less were recovered. Human review stays essential. This is public-data validation; movement tracking and independent farm trials remain unvalidated.
scenes.action_zh: 显示真实24像素漏检和<=32像素分组26/70→19/70；再显示人工deferred原始结果。源图坐标，无GPS或硬件。
scenes.provenance: Measured limitations / public agricultural domain only
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

scenes.title: 明确当前成果与下一步
scenes.narration: Inspectable Meta evidence. Traceable human decisions. A tested local recognition prototype. Next: cloud integration and farmer trials. GreenPoint. Every judgment has a frame.
scenes.action_zh: 清楚并列已上线Meta复核与本地农业原型，末尾产品名、URL、下一步；不宣称农业原型已上线。
scenes.provenance: Online Meta review + local research / no hardware
scenes.url: Local research evidence bundled with this submission

storyline_zh: 23像素判断分歧 → 一次真实Meta复核与导出 → Muse工具调用 → 本地农业识别 → 同图精度提升与去重 → 保留失败 → 当前成果与下一步。
filming_note_zh: 线上段使用已有真实生产录屏；农业段为实际本地推理输出和公开标注的剪辑展示，持续标识Local research prototype，尚未部署。新图像只作原始像素放大和测量结果可视化，不伪造网页或推理进度。
narration_method: New ElevenLabs Bella American female narration for all 11 revised scenes; provider character timestamps drive captions.
narration_note_zh: 本版11段旁白全部使用此次验证的ElevenLabs Bella美国女声生成；保留原始音频和字符时间戳，不读取密钥到提交包。
